name: noBS-CAD browser
install:
rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
bash -lc 'command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null || cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.13.1 --locked'
npm ci
npm run build:wasm
npx playwright install chromium

terminals.name: vite
terminals.description: Vite browser app for UI and Playwright work on :5173
